None (Second & Third) |virtual_item = {{Color|Other|Plushie}} skin for [[Pyromancer]] |toy_type = Plushie }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Pyromancer Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It was made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the Default Level 5 [[Pyromancer]]. Anybody who bought the toy from the in-game Merch Store will receive the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} skin for [[Pyromancer]]. If bought on the [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games store], it will not come with any rewards. It is made out of plush fabric and polypropylene cotton, its size measures 11 inches (27.94 centimetres) tall, 8.3 inches (21.082 centimetres) wide and 9.4 inches (23.876 centimetres) deep. Its mask and flamethrower can be detached. ==Official Description== *'''Online (Third)''' *:Turn up the heat with the new Pyromancer Plush. Equipped with a removable face shield and flamethrower, this fiery friend is sure to heat up your collection. Do not get burned by missing out and grab yours today. The in-game reward is only included with purchases made in Roblox. Items purchased from shop.paradoxum.games do not include an in-game reward. *'''Online (Second)''' *:Turn up the heat with the new Pyromancer Plush! Equipped with a removable face shield and flamethrower, this fiery friend is sure to heat up your collection. *'''Online (First)''' *:Turn up the heat with the new Pyromancer Plush! Equipped with a removable face shield and flamethrower, this fiery friend is sure to heat up your collection. Don’t get burned by missing out— grab yours today! This plush comes with a FREE in-game skin!! ==Prices & Stores== Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''Pyromancer Plush''' can be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $34.99. Originally, it had a price of $29.99. If bought as part of the now unavailable Pyromancer Bundle, which also included the [[Pyromancer]] pin, it costed $35.98. It had a stock of 2,000 originally. Despite being offsale, the bundle price increased to $38.68 after April 2025. During the Black Friday 2024 Sale, it could be bought for $25.49, while the bundle had a cost of $30.58. During the Black Friday 2025 Sale, it had a cost of $28.99. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Showcase}} PyromancerPlushShowcase1.png PyromancerPlushShowcase2.png PyromancerPlushShowcase3.png PyromancerPlushShowcase4.png PyromancerPlushShowcase5.png PyromancerPlushShowcase6.png PyromancerPlushShowcase7.png PyromancerPlushShowcase8.png PyromancerPlushShowcase9.png PyromancerPlushShowcase10.png PyromancerPlushShowcase11.png PyromancerPlushShowcase12.png PyromancerPlushShowcase13.png PyromancerPlushShowcase14.png PyromancerPlushShowcase15.png PyromancerPlushShowcase16.png PyromancerPlushShowcase17.png {{GalleryHeader|Banners}} PyromancerPlushBanner1.png PyromancerPlushBanner2.png PyromancerPlushBanner3.png Pyromancer Plush Promotional Banner Pyromancer Plush Promotional Banner (Release) }} ==Trivia== *The '''Pyromancer Plush''' has a different face from the [[Pyromancer]] in-game. {{ToyNavBox}} [[Category:Plushies]]
